run_metadata.coverage_summary: All source tiers were attempted this run via five parallel research passes (Tier 1 Commonwealth; Tier 1 states NSW/VIC/QLD; Tier 1 states/territories WA/SA/TAS/NT/ACT; Tier 2 councils/GBEs/universities/health; Tier 3 private sector/construction). However, NO opportunity could be verified: outbound HTTPS page fetching is blocked by the session's organization egress policy. Every WebFetch call returned EGRESS_BLOCKED and every direct curl returned '403 CONNECT tunnel failed' for all hosts, including a neutral control request to en.wikipedia.org — confirming a session-wide egress block rather than a portal login wall. WebSearch (which routes through the Anthropic API, not the egress proxy) still worked and surfaced candidate opportunities and source leads, but the spec's fidelity rule requires every detail to come from the actual notice or its documents. Because no notice page could be opened, all such candidates are unverified (and several carry demonstrably stale/past close dates), so this run records ZERO tenders and ZERO confirmed new sources. The strongest unverified candidates and new-source leads are preserved in gaps and recommended_seed_additions for a future unblocked run. No data was invented.
gaps: CRITICAL BLOCKER: Outbound HTTPS is blocked for this session. WebFetch returns {"error_type":"EGRESS_BLOCKED"} for all hosts and direct curl returns 'curl: (56) CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403'. A neutral control fetch to https://en.wikipedia.org also returned 403, proving the block is session-wide (organization egress policy), not portal-specific. The proxy README (/root/.ccr/README.md) states a 403/EGRESS_BLOCKED means the destination is not on the egress allowlist and must be reported, not retried or routed around. Proxy status shows enabled=true, bundleCoversEveryHost=true, no relay failures — consistent with a deny-by-default allowlist permitting only infrastructure hosts (Anthropic API, npm, pypi, crates) and no external tender domains.

Tier 2 (councils/GBEs/universities/health) — VendorPanel public tenders, brisbane.qld.gov.au, sydneywater.com.au, portal.tenderlink.com (Melbourne/Monash/etc.), NSW Health Gateway, CSIRO procurement all EGRESS_BLOCKED.

Tier 3 (private sector/construction) — service.ariba.com (SAP Ariba Discovery), bhp.com, estimateone.com, gateway.icn.org.au and all major-buyer supplier portals EGRESS_BLOCKED. Invitation-only consultancy RFPs remain out of scope by definition; registration/login-gated corporate RFx could not be recorded because even the public portal pages were unreachable. No corporate tenders were invented.

UNVERIFIED CANDIDATE OPPORTUNITIES (surfaced by WebSearch only; NOT fetched, NOT recorded as tenders, must be confirmed on the notice page before use): (1) Tasmania — 'Aged Care Greenfield Sites' EOI, Dept of Health TAS, ~opened 26 Sep / closes 6 Nov 2026, up to 13 sites, news-corroborated (tenders.tas.gov.au). (2) Victoria — Melbourne Water 'Field Services Panel (FSP) renewal' RFT, ~opened 10 Sep / closes 27 Oct 2026, via Buying for Victoria. (3) National — Australia Post 'EOI New Over-the-Counter (OTC) Services', ~released 14 Sep / closes 14 Oct 2026 (auspost.com.au EOI PDF). (4) NT/QTOL — T26-1272 Hidden Valley Motorsport pit garage shade structure (close 26 Oct), RFT0791 Power & Water bulk bottled water (close 21 Oct), T26-1192 Yuendumu Police Station water upgrade (close 13 Oct), RFF26-0130 network management RFF (close 9 Oct). (5) QLD — Brisbane City Council: ex-TC Alfred sports field remediation (close 21 Oct), traffic signal hardware supply (close 22 Oct), City Hall Precinct Model (close 23 Oct). (6) VIC — City of Melbourne CN102954 Stolen Generations Marker bronze casting (close 5 Oct), CN102988 nitrous oxide/gas cylinder recycling (close 12 Oct). (7) NSW — HealthShare NSW HSSP_HC25_979 pharmaceuticals RFT supplementary (close 8 Nov; possibly stale). (8) VIC — Monash University unoccupied site maintenance (close 31 Oct).

The proxy status diagnostic (curl to the __agentproxy/status endpoint) was denied by the sandbox classifier as credential exploration when a subagent attempted it, though it succeeded at the top level and reported no relay failures.

RECOMMENDATION TO RESTORE COVERAGE: Add the tender-portal domains to this environment's egress allowlist (or run the routine where WebFetch is permitted). Until then daily runs can only produce empty, honest results because no notice can be verified.
